lines.text: Qua-le-di-no u-s-qua-si-go-se u-dla-si-dv-e-he na-tle-gv u-yo-hu-sv-i; wu-ya-nv-hv-no a-s-go-hi-tsu-qui di-ti-ni-do-hi, u-dv-dv-ne, ye-li-s-go go-hi-gi gv-wa-yo-hu-sv-hi, u-dv-ne-i.
lines.english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
lines.emitted_text: waleanho uhskwanikolhe utlalhithv ehe natlekhv wiyohuhsv'i wuyhanvhonho hskohi tskwatithinitohi uthvtvnhe elihsko kohiki kawayohuhsvhi utvnhehi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏃ ᏄᏩᏁᎸ ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏗᏘᏂᏙᎯ, ᏦᏩ ᏚᏲᎯᏎᎴ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ.
lines.text: Gv-ni-ge-sv-no nu-wa-ne-lv a-s-go-hi-tsu-qui di-ti-ni-do-hi, Tso-wa du-yo-hi-se-le a-ye-lv-i.
lines.english: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
lines.emitted_text: kvnakehsona nuwanelv hskohi ysakwatithinitoh tsokwa tuyohihselv ayelv

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏩᏒᏃ ᎤᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎠᏄᏬ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᏒ ᎠᏰᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏄᏬᎩᎯ ᏙᎴᏛ ᎤᏪᏣᏄᎳᏅ, ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎤᏅᏁ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎠᏍᎪᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏅᏯ ᎤᏪᏌᏆᎴᎴᎢ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ ᎤᏁᎢ.
lines.text: U-wa-sv-no u-si-do-li do-le-dv a-nu-wo, a-le u-de-sv a-ye-lv-i, a-le a-nu-wo-gi-hi do-le-dv u-we-tsa-nu-la-nv, a-tse-li-s-dv u-nv-ne na-s-gi nv-yo-hi a-s-go-sv-i, a-le nv-ya u-we-sa-qua-le-le-i a-tse-li-s-dv ga-lo-hi-s-di-yi u-ne-i.
lines.english: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
lines.emitted_text: uwhahsanho uhsitolhi tholeta anhawo ale utelhv ayelv'i ale anhawokihi tholeta uwetsanulana ayelihstv unvne naki nvyohi ahskolhvhi ilenvya uwehsakwalelhe'i atselihstv kalohihstiyi unhe'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎺᎵᏃ ᎹᎩᏕᎵ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎺᎵ ᏦᏏ ᎤᏥ ᎤᏂᎪᎮ ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏂᏅᏅᎢ.
lines.text: Me-li-no Ma-gi-de-li e-hi, a-le Me-li Tso-si u-tsi u-ni-go-he na-hna u-ni-nv-nv-i.
lines.english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
lines.emitted_text: melinho makatili ehi ale ameli tsohsa utsi unikohe nanha uninvnv'i
